verdict.rationale: Portkey is an AI gateway that logs every request it processes, so control over data retention and deletion is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents logging, log sharing and filtering, and guardrails against sensitive-data leaks. None of it mentions retention periods, log deletion, or opting out of data storage, and adjacent features like guardrails do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
